centreline.license_evidence: Official dataset page links Open Government Licence – Toronto; CKAN license fields are null and isopen false. No City clarification obtained.
centreline.selection: Whole source lines intersecting bbox, feature codes 201100–202002 and 204001/204002; no clipping or geometric snapping. Boundary edges retain outside endpoints.

limits: Centreline topology is source intersection IDs, not a lane graph. No inferred direction rules, signal phases, speeds, widths or traffic interactions.
GTFS shapes describe service paths, not surveyed track geometry. Nearby stops do not imply a valid pedestrian transfer.

transit.selection: Shapes and stops of trips active 2026-10-22; shape lines clipped to bbox for context only. No new vehicle schedules or pedestrian transfer edges inferred.
